resources.name: Maple Leaves
resources.from: First clears (skirmish 40, elite 70, boss 120 ...) and repeat wins (8 / 14 / 24, x the rank multiplier); daily notices (40-1,100) and the daily / weekly quest tiers; PvP (4 a win); raids (damage / 48); achievements; the Gauntlet, Async and dungeon runs.
resources.spent: Packs (50 / 120 / 250, Advanced x12), levelling and the Forge, prestige, finishes (Refine), Nest building and training, Tavern recruits, Energy upgrades (150 a step), dungeon key ring, Raid Tickets (300), Rename Tickets (250).

resources.name: Gold Leaves
resources.from: S / SS / SSS daily notices (6 / 15 / 30); daily dungeon floors (hidden today, DAILY_DUNGEONS_HIDDEN); raid claims.
resources.spent: The Tidemire Chest (10) and Highcrest Case (30), the Prism finish (5), Advanced packs.
resources.notes: The rarest everyday currency: a dedicated player sees well under 1 S notice a day.

resources.name: Magic Dust
resources.from: First clears (20 / 68 / 169); daily notices (the main faucet, ~50-1,200) and quest tiers; raids; elite / boss repeats (5 / 10); melting (disenchanting) cards.
resources.spent: Levelling and limit breaks (the Forge road), prestige, finishes, crafting cards, Materia crystals (bench), Nest building and training, Tavern recruits, Max Energy steps, the key ring.

resources.name: Metal
resources.from: Weekly quest tiers (3 + 1), a raid win (1), Gauntlet / Async / dungeon runs (2), SSS notices (3), the Tidemire Chest (1), achievements.
resources.spent: Nothing spends it today (no cost lists Metal); raid claims weigh it.
resources.notes: Earned, never spent: a candidate for the Forge tiers or the Blacksmith.

resources.name: Kibble
resources.from: Conquest first clears (1 / 2 / 3 / 5 by kind); repeat wins 15% for 1; a grown baby +2.
resources.spent: Training a Level-0 card to Level 1 in the Nest (2, +1 per card of that species already raised, up to 8).

resources.name: Beer
resources.from: 1 every Monday once the Tavern is open, +1 for each of the first two weekly quest tiers; you hold at most 3.
resources.spent: Tavern recruits (1 each, with Dust and Maple Leaves; a Rare also an Iron Shard).

resources.name: Laurels
resources.from: PvP only: 3 a win, 2 a draw, 1 a loss.
resources.spent: Nothing yet (planned: a Laurel shelf, cosmetics, Arena cards).

resources.name: Krooni
resources.from: Retired (TU2, 2026-10-23); the Highcrest Case no longer gives them.
resources.spent: Nothing.

resources.name: Food tokens
resources.spent: Nothing.

resources.name: Energy
resources.from: 1 every 5 minutes (288 a day) up to the cap: 20, raised to 30 (Nest), 50 (Forge), 60 (Tavern) with Dust and Materia; +5 free a day; Energy capsules (+8, from rewards).
resources.spent: Conquest fights: 1-2 a fight on Maps 0-1, 4 on Map 3, 7 on Map 10, 2x for bosses (mapEnergyBase); Sweeps.

resources.name: Energy capsule
resources.from: Reward tokens on some fights and achievements; the Map 2 capsule.
resources.spent: Opened for +8 Energy.

resources.name: PvP tickets
resources.from: 10 a day (1 an hour).
resources.spent: A PvP match each.

resources.name: Raid points
resources.from: 1 a day, held up to 10.
resources.spent: A raid attempt each.

resources.name: Raid Ticket
resources.from: S notices or better at 40% (~0.6 a week); the shop (300 Maple Leaves, sometimes in stock); quests.
resources.spent: An extra raid attempt.
resources.notes: Owner 19:27 #16: should cost more and need some advanced resources.

resources.name: Dungeon keys / tickets
resources.from: A daily dungeon ticket each day (hold 3); the key ring holds 3-5 (upgrade 800 / 2,000 Maple Leaves + Strange Materia).
resources.spent: Entering a daily dungeon (hidden today).

resources.name: Rename Ticket
resources.from: The shop (250 Maple Leaves); a gift before 2026-10-26.
resources.spent: Renaming your guild.

resources.name: Field-kit items
resources.from: Conquest wins (2% per Energy used, at most 3 a day), A+ notices (1-3), weekly tiers (3 / 2 / 1), item bosses (from Map 12), the shop.
resources.spent: Used in a fight (Draught, Kindling, Scout map, Firepot, Honeycake, Whetstone, Caltrops); hold 5 each.

resources.name: Iron Shard (Materia)
resources.from: Elite first clear 1, boss 2, raid / final boss 3; any repeat win 15%.
resources.spent: Max Energy steps, Rare Tavern recruits, Blacksmith equipment.

resources.name: River Pearl (Materia)
resources.from: Boss first clear 1.
resources.spent: Max Energy steps, Blacksmith.

resources.name: Tempering Stone (Materia)
resources.from: Boss first clear 1, raid / final boss 2; elite / boss repeats 5%.
resources.spent: Max Energy (Forge, Tavern steps).

resources.name: Ember Core (Materia)
resources.from: Raid / final boss first clear 1; an SS / SSS win 10%.
resources.spent: Blacksmith (Siege Hammer, Dragonscale Mail, Lava Waders).

resources.name: Dragon Scale (Materia)
resources.from: The Scale Trail.
resources.spent: Dragonscale Mail.

resources.name: Abyssal Ink (Materia)
resources.from: The raid.
resources.spent: Blacksmith.

resources.name: Strange Materia
resources.from: Map bosses' first clears (Maps 12, 15, 25, 30: 1 / 1 / 2 / 3).
resources.spent: Forge tier upgrades, the key ring.

resources.name: Materia crystals (Ember, Tide, Grove, Stone)
resources.from: Crafted on the Forge bench from Magic Dust.
resources.spent: Enchanting a card (one socket).

resources.name: Materia Unit / Mote
resources.from: A unit of account, not held: a Unit = {"dust":675,"gold":450}, a Mote = the Unit / 45.
resources.spent: Prices the Forge road (Lv 0 to 1 costs a Mote).

resources.name: Trophy shards (per raid)
resources.from: Raid attempts and claims.
resources.spent: Crafting that raid's cards in the Forge's Raid tab.

resources.name: Cloud shards (raid)
resources.from: The online raid.
resources.spent: Raid claims.

resources.name: Forge credit
resources.from: Fusing duplicates (a share of the card's road, by rarity: duplicateDivisor).
resources.spent: Levelling that card.

resources.name: Bramble spares
resources.from: A map boss beaten again at S+; bramble drops.
resources.spent: Fused into that bramble's road (Reinforce).

resources.name: Upgrade fragments (finishes)
resources.from: Not in the game yet (owner 19:27 #14: "Foil treatment upgrade fragments needed / bars need 10% more").
resources.spent: Finishes are paid in Dust, Maple Leaves and Gold Leaves today (REFINE_LADDER).

resources.name: Eggs
resources.from: First clears 2-20% by kind, repeats 0.1% per Energy x kind, raids 1%; guaranteed on Map 1 (1-3) and Map 3.
resources.spent: Set in a nest: hatch in 6-10 h into a random Common-Rare card of the egg's type at Level 0.

resources.name: Rescued babies
resources.from: A 6% rescue after any won Conquest fight.
resources.spent: Grow in a nest in 4 h into a random card of its type at Level 0 (+2 Kibble).

resources.name: Free / faction packs
resources.from: Map bosses (MAP_FREE_PACKS: Maps 3, 7, 10, 11, 13, 15, 16, 18, 20), Map 0's 0-2 faction pack, first-clear pack cards.
resources.spent: Opened at once.

resources.name: Player XP / Hero XP
resources.from: Wins and notices (25-750 XP).
resources.spent: Levels and milestones.

resources.name: In-fight resources (Lumber, Stone, Metal ore, Grace, Devilry, Acorns, fight Gold)
resources.from: Cards and brambles during a fight.
resources.spent: Card costs during that fight; nothing carries over.

gatorReached.note: Maps 0-4 cleared: Map 5 (Gatorback Swamp) opens the Hedgerow Pouch (50 Maple Leaves)
